title: Show that the system is working
statement: Show a visible waiting state whenever the system is working on a learner's answer, so a pause reads as thinking rather than broken.
detail: A Grade 3 reading build's case for approval reports that waiting is now visible: every pause while the guide reads a child's answer shows a spinner, so a child can tell the difference between thinking and broken.
against: The document states the change and its reason but reports no measurement of its effect.

evidence.quote: pause shows a spinner, so a child can tell the difference between thinking and broken.
